title: Exceptional customer service!
text: Exceptional customer service!. The photo must be "photo-shopped" because my little cover would not fit on my table. HOWEVER, customer service was exceptional and that is worth a great deal. Measure your table carefully, also you may need clips or some other devices to keep it in place.
